claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object | Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The fortress alternates between a carried statuette and a deployed tower, and later commands target the created structure and its door. Current activation phases can attach only to self, target, area, or mark.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is creating a persistent adamantine tower with size, door, AC, HP, resistances, immunities, and damage that carries across shrinking and re-expanding. The current surface has alter_item_kind but no honest created-object payload.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: deployed_object_toggle_with_persistent_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Instant Fortress needs a reversible deployed-object lifecycle: deploy tower, push occupants clear, allow later reversion only when empty, preserve tower damage across forms, and support object-specific commands such as opening the door.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_instant_fortress.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
